text: Mr Ireton Todd is a good host, and has tracked him here, without even waiting to take off his fancy-dress.” “What man do you mean?” “I mean the man with comically ill-fitting clothes you saw running across the ploughed field. Hadn’t you better go and investigate him? He will be rather impatient to get back to his champagne, from which he ran away in such a hurry, when the convict with the gun hove in sight.” “Do you seriously mean--” began the official. “Why, look here, Mr Usher,” said Father Brown quietly, “you said the machine couldn’t make a mistake; and in one sense it didn’t. But the other machine did; the machine that worked it.
